ARCH: a boundary module for it
tests: R1 the model per mode comes from MODEL_FOR_MODE only; the call runs under the reference given, with the pack's system prompt, within the segment bound

R2 the provider follows the reference's kind: apikey to MODEL_ENDPOINT with the key in x-api-key only; signin to the member's own runner instance named by idFromName(member), never a new one, with the credential {kind: signin, member, secret} (R16), for one turn and a conversation alike; unusable references (subscription included) and a missing runner are refused with no call; the runner's NOT_SIGNED_IN and NOT_THIS_MEMBER pass through unchanged

R3 never throws: a throw or a non-JSON body is silent (detail ≤ 200); a non-200 is refused with status, type and message ≤ 300; a 429 is not retried; stop_reason refusal is refused type refusal; the runner's failures alike
R4 on the apikey path every request marks the system prompt (with the pack's resident layer), the tool definitions and the transcript cacheable
R5 every outcome that reached the provider carries usage with the five figures on both paths; an unstated figure is null, never 0; total_cost_usd only where stated

R6 a conversation ends on the final tool, on stopped turns or bytes before sending, exhausted after maxTurns (12 by default), or a silent or refused turn; every tool call gets a result; usage sums with null kept

R6 every answer carrying usage carries calls: on the apikey path each request answered with an outcome counts one and a stopped one none; on the signin path the runner's num_turns, null where it states none
R7 on the signin path only the named tools are offered, each relayed call is performed by onTool with its result sent back on the same connection, and R6's endings hold
R8 a reference's secret is in no returned value, transcript or console output, even when the provider echoes it; a second call without a reference makes no call
R9 it reads no environment variable or binding for a credential: with keys in env and no reference every call is refused and nothing is sent
R10 it reaches no address but MODEL_ENDPOINT and the runner binding, and names no place in its behaviour or outward text

Purpose a turn reaches the provider the account reference names (today Anthropic's Claude only): a member's own, a project's or the team's API key to the Messages API, a member's sign-in to that member's own runner; the reference arrives per call and is never kept

R11 a group-level reference is the team's API key and a project-level one a project's, each sent exactly as a member's: only with kind apikey; a group or project reference of another kind, or a level other than member, project or group, is refused with no call
R13 MODEL_PRICES holds USD per million input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens for every MODEL_FOR_MODE model, a reviewed edit beside it

R13 on the apikey path every outcome's usage adds estimated_cost_usd from its figures at the model's prices; total_cost_usd stays as the provider states it; a provider's own estimated_cost_usd is not taken

R13 a null figure on the apikey path is priced at the model's highest rate, never as zero: its count bounded by the request sent (input side by its UTF-8 bytes, output by max_tokens); a model the table does not price is priced at the table's highest rate
R13 on the signin path estimated_cost_usd is always null, whatever the runner states; total_cost_usd stays as stated

R12 record text reaches the model only inside tool results: rowFacts' every field, a sub-session contract's record fields and every onTool answer, on both paths; system and the turns' own text carry none; search results go as search_result blocks
R14 a page's picture reaches the model only inside the tool_result answering its call, as an image block sent unchanged on the apikey path; the meter counts its bytes
R14 R15 on the signin path a runner that does not answer agent-runner R24's capability refuses a picture IMAGE_NOT_RELAYED and nothing is sent, never dropping it

R15 on the signin path a tool_result holding an image block is relayed through a runner answering agent-runner R24, the block unchanged beside its text blocks in order, only inside the result answering its call; the meter counts its bytes

R16 a signin reference's secret reaches the stub runner's first frame only, inside the conversation request's credential, and no outcome, usage, detail, transcript, header, relayed result or console output, even when the runner echoes it

R16 a signin reference with no non-empty string secret answers refused SIGNIN_NOT_HELD with no runner call; a runner's SIGNIN_NOT_HELD and SIGNIN_TOKEN_REFUSED pass through with that type, never reworded
R16 the upgrade request carries x-civicsmith-trace and x-civicsmith-member-ref when the caller gave them, and nothing secret; control: an apikey reference is unchanged
R17 the report tool states its bounds in its description and enumerates condition from the contract's conditions; with none, condition stays a free string
R18 apikey path: a refused final call is handed back once as an error result and the second ends the conversation; two refused calls still end on the second's input
R18 signin path: a refused final call is handed back once as an error result and the second ends the conversation; two refused calls still end on the second's input
R19 a sub-session runs on claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort and every other conversation on claude-opus-5-5 at medium, on each path; no request names claude-opus-5
R19 a sub-session runs on claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort and every other conversation on claude-opus-5-5 at medium, on each path; no request names claude-opus-5 > <name not written out, line 1506>
R20 the meaningrows tool enumerates the contract's arms, takes ids, and says how to reach a document; no subject id is in any description
R21 converse answers the model and effort its requests named, on each path
R22 the meaningrows tool describes a 64-token snippet and a passage call sends snippet 64, on each path; another arm sends none
R23 judge_plan and judge_compose enumerate condition from the list handed in; with none handed it stays a string and the other tools carry none
R24 judge_compose alone offers disagreements, at most 10 pairs of two level enums, described as contradiction about a record

R2 the provider follows the reference's kind: apikey to MODEL_ENDPOINT with the key in x-api-key only; signin to the member's own runner instance named by idFromName(member), never a new one, with the credential {kind: signin, member, secret} (R16), for one turn and a conversation alike; unusable references (subscription included) and a missing runner are refused with no call; the runner's NOT_SIGNED_IN and NOT_THIS_MEMBER pass through unchanged

R3 never throws: a throw or a non-JSON body is silent (detail ≤ 200); a non-200 is refused with status, type and message ≤ 300; a 429 is not retried; stop_reason refusal is refused type refusal; the runner's failures alike
R4 on the apikey path every request marks the system prompt (with the pack's resident layer), the tool definitions and the transcript cacheable
R5 every outcome that reached the provider carries usage with the five figures on both paths; an unstated figure is null, never 0; total_cost_usd only where stated

R6 a conversation ends on the final tool, on stopped turns or bytes before sending, exhausted after maxTurns (12 by default), or a silent or refused turn; every tool call gets a result; usage sums with null kept

R6 every answer carrying usage carries calls: on the apikey path each request answered with an outcome counts one and a stopped one none; on the signin path the runner's num_turns, null where it states none
R7 on the signin path only the named tools are offered, each relayed call is performed by onTool with its result sent back on the same connection, and R6's endings hold
R8 a reference's secret is in no returned value, transcript or console output, even when the provider echoes it; a second call without a reference makes no call
R9 it reads no environment variable or binding for a credential: with keys in env and no reference every call is refused and nothing is sent
R10 it reaches no address but MODEL_ENDPOINT and the runner binding, and names no place in its behaviour or outward text

Purpose a turn reaches the provider the account reference names (today Anthropic's Claude only): a member's own, a project's or the team's API key to the Messages API, a member's sign-in to that member's own runner; the reference arrives per call and is never kept

R11 a group-level reference is the team's API key and a project-level one a project's, each sent exactly as a member's: only with kind apikey; a group or project reference of another kind, or a level other than member, project or group, is refused with no call
R13 MODEL_PRICES holds USD per million input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens for every MODEL_FOR_MODE model, a reviewed edit beside it

R13 on the apikey path every outcome's usage adds estimated_cost_usd from its figures at the model's prices; total_cost_usd stays as the provider states it; a provider's own estimated_cost_usd is not taken

R13 a null figure on the apikey path is priced at the model's highest rate, never as zero: its count bounded by the request sent (input side by its UTF-8 bytes, output by max_tokens); a model the table does not price is priced at the table's highest rate
R13 on the signin path estimated_cost_usd is always null, whatever the runner states; total_cost_usd stays as stated

R12 record text reaches the model only inside tool results: rowFacts' every field, a sub-session contract's record fields and every onTool answer, on both paths; system and the turns' own text carry none; search results go as search_result blocks
R14 a page's picture reaches the model only inside the tool_result answering its call, as an image block sent unchanged on the apikey path; the meter counts its bytes
R14 R15 on the signin path a runner that does not answer agent-runner R24's capability refuses a picture IMAGE_NOT_RELAYED and nothing is sent, never dropping it

R15 on the signin path a tool_result holding an image block is relayed through a runner answering agent-runner R24, the block unchanged beside its text blocks in order, only inside the result answering its call; the meter counts its bytes

R16 a signin reference's secret reaches the stub runner's first frame only, inside the conversation request's credential, and no outcome, usage, detail, transcript, header, relayed result or console output, even when the runner echoes it

R16 a signin reference with no non-empty string secret answers refused SIGNIN_NOT_HELD with no runner call; a runner's SIGNIN_NOT_HELD and SIGNIN_TOKEN_REFUSED pass through with that type, never reworded
R16 the upgrade request carries x-civicsmith-trace and x-civicsmith-member-ref when the caller gave them, and nothing secret; control: an apikey reference is unchanged
R17 the report tool states its bounds in its description and enumerates condition from the contract's conditions; with none, condition stays a free string
R18 apikey path: a refused final call is handed back once as an error result and the second ends the conversation; two refused calls still end on the second's input
R18 signin path: a refused final call is handed back once as an error result and the second ends the conversation; two refused calls still end on the second's input
R19 a sub-session runs on claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort and every other conversation on claude-opus-5-5 at medium, on each path; no request names claude-opus-5
R19 a sub-session runs on claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort and every other conversation on claude-opus-5-5 at medium, on each path; no request names claude-opus-5 > <name not written out, line 1506>
R20 the meaningrows tool enumerates the contract's arms, takes ids, and says how to reach a document; no subject id is in any description
R21 converse answers the model and effort its requests named, on each path
R22 the meaningrows tool describes a 64-token snippet and a passage call sends snippet 64, on each path; another arm sends none
R23 judge_plan and judge_compose enumerate condition from the list handed in; with none handed it stays a string and the other tools carry none
R24 judge_compose alone offers disagreements, at most 10 pairs of two level enums, described as contradiction about a record

R1 the model per mode comes from MODEL_FOR_MODE only; the call runs under the reference given, with the pack's system prompt, within the segment bound

R2 the provider follows the reference's kind: apikey to MODEL_ENDPOINT with the key in x-api-key only; signin to the member's own runner instance named by idFromName(member), never a new one, with the credential {kind: signin, member, secret} (R16), for one turn and a conversation alike; unusable references (subscription included) and a missing runner are refused with no call; the runner's NOT_SIGNED_IN and NOT_THIS_MEMBER pass through unchanged

R3 never throws: a throw or a non-JSON body is silent (detail ≤ 200); a non-200 is refused with status, type and message ≤ 300; a 429 is not retried; stop_reason refusal is refused type refusal; the runner's failures alike
R4 on the apikey path every request marks the system prompt (with the pack's resident layer), the tool definitions and the transcript cacheable
R5 every outcome that reached the provider carries usage with the five figures on both paths; an unstated figure is null, never 0; total_cost_usd only where stated

R6 a conversation ends on the final tool, on stopped turns or bytes before sending, exhausted after maxTurns (12 by default), or a silent or refused turn; every tool call gets a result; usage sums with null kept

R6 every answer carrying usage carries calls: on the apikey path each request answered with an outcome counts one and a stopped one none; on the signin path the runner's num_turns, null where it states none
R7 on the signin path only the named tools are offered, each relayed call is performed by onTool with its result sent back on the same connection, and R6's endings hold
R8 a reference's secret is in no returned value, transcript or console output, even when the provider echoes it; a second call without a reference makes no call
R9 it reads no environment variable or binding for a credential: with keys in env and no reference every call is refused and nothing is sent
R10 it reaches no address but MODEL_ENDPOINT and the runner binding, and names no place in its behaviour or outward text

Purpose a turn reaches the provider the account reference names (today Anthropic's Claude only): a member's own, a project's or the team's API key to the Messages API, a member's sign-in to that member's own runner; the reference arrives per call and is never kept

R11 a group-level reference is the team's API key and a project-level one a project's, each sent exactly as a member's: only with kind apikey; a group or project reference of another kind, or a level other than member, project or group, is refused with no call
R13 MODEL_PRICES holds USD per million input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens for every MODEL_FOR_MODE model, a reviewed edit beside it

R13 on the apikey path every outcome's usage adds estimated_cost_usd from its figures at the model's prices; total_cost_usd stays as the provider states it; a provider's own estimated_cost_usd is not taken

R13 a null figure on the apikey path is priced at the model's highest rate, never as zero: its count bounded by the request sent (input side by its UTF-8 bytes, output by max_tokens); a model the table does not price is priced at the table's highest rate
R13 on the signin path estimated_cost_usd is always null, whatever the runner states; total_cost_usd stays as stated
